title: Gstarsoft releases GstarCAD 2026 Beta with enhanced multi-core CPU optimization
summary: Gstarsoft announces the beta release of GstarCAD 2026, delivering significant speed improvements in drawing layouts, 3D orbiting, and dynamic block manipulations. Designers can experience faster processing of heavy DWG files.

title: Autodesk Fusion May 2026 update introduces smart manufacturing features
summary: The May update for Autodesk Fusion brings enhancements to sheet metal simulation, generative design constraints for 3-axis CNC milling, and unified electronics schematic capture workspaces. Perfect for integrated CAD/CAM workflows.

title: IFC 4.3 officially ratified as ISO 16739-1:2026 global standard
summary: buildingSMART International celebrates the formal ISO publication of IFC 4.3, establishing it as the international open standard for BIM infrastructure exchange across railways, roads, bridges, and marine networks.

title: Open BIM announcements and IFC ecosystem updates
summary: buildingSMART continues to coordinate open standards for BIM exchange; following their announcements helps you judge which interoperability stories matter before you adopt new tools or workflows. Use this portal as the authoritative feed for IFC-related program news.

title: Construction tech and BIM practice – Autodesk editorial channel
summary: The construction blog covers project delivery, collaboration, and field-to-office workflows that sit next to CAD and BIM workflows. Skim it when you want context on how vendor roadmaps talk to day-to-day documentation and coordination challenges.

title: Product and release notes for Rhino
summary: McNeel’s news hub is where you verify release cadence and platform notes before committing to Grasshopper or Rhino builds with your team. Follow their official updates rather than rumor threads when you plan curricula or rollout dates.

title: Engineering design and manufacturing coverage
summary: This outlet regularly covers automation, workforce, and product-design stories that sit beside CAD skills—useful when you are connecting software practice to career and supply-chain context. Open the site for the full article feed; our line here is only orientation.

title: AEC product and practice stories for practitioners
summary: AEC Magazine publishes project and tool coverage relevant to visualization, collaboration, and delivery—good companion reading when you are building a personal reading list next to hands-on CAD exercises. Treat our blurb as a map, not a substitute for their reporting.
